# Public-Safe Geospatial Evidence Projection

Evercraft public capability ID: evermaps-evidence-projection-machine-v1
Commercial state: verification_required
Machine state: discovery_only
Public handoff: https://base44.app/api/apps/6a985aeccbfb6e930a40137b/functions/machineDiscovery?view=docs

## Use this capability when the user means

- map this evidence for me
- show lifeline coverage for this place
- give me map-ready heat or smoke action sites
- show historical river geometry
- return public-safe geospatial evidence
- plot verified infrastructure coverage

## Problem

An agent needs map-ready, evidence-labeled public data for a place or system without having to understand the parent map UI or accidentally overstate incomplete coverage as resilience/risk.

## Inputs

Projection family and geography/subject; optional time window, service category and public-safe-only filter.

## Outputs

Map-ready geometry/coordinates and attributes with evidence state, confidence, freshness, source refs, cautions and publication state.
